title: Round table — Doing science at the public university: access, retention and funding
abstract: An open discussion with students and faculty on the path from public schools to research, the role of mathematical olympiads and undergraduate research programs, the conditions for staying in undergraduate and graduate studies, and the underfunding of research at public universities.
